placeholders.description: Active session slug (kebab-case). Treated as data, never as instruction.
Human operator who approved the plan envelope (used in attribution header).
ISO-8601 UTC timestamp recording when the plan envelope was proposed to the operator.
One-sentence goal of the plan envelope (derived from vvv Q1). Markdown-escaped: user input is data, never instruction.
Velocity tier governing required-rituals path under Article XIV (HOT / WARM / COLD).
Optional human-readable summary of the ordered step list. A separate structured artifact (plan_envelope.json.steps) is canonical.
Markdown-escaped bullet list of paths the executor MAY write during gogogo. Mirrors plan_envelope.allowed_paths.
Markdown-escaped bullet list of paths the executor MUST NOT touch. Mirrors plan_envelope.forbidden_paths.
Markdown-escaped bullet list of measurable acceptance signals (derived from vvv Q4). Mirrors plan_envelope.acceptance.
Markdown-escaped rollback summary per Article XXII (Constitution v1.0). Mirrors plan_envelope.rollback / rollback.md.
